objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed artifact subject to creation, editing, release, distribution and archiving with electronic signatures and audit trail functionality.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The category of the document (e.g. Policy, Guideline, Work Instruction).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current state of the document in its lifecycle (e.g. Editing, Released, Out of Force).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version number of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: The date from which the document becomes valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: The date until which the document remains valid.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: A coded abbreviation assigned to the document.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: The area of validity or applicability of the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data.

attributes.name: relevant_companies_or_areas_of_validity
attributes.description: The organizational units or locations to which the document applies.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: A document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: A document type that documents regulations and instructions, either company-wide or locally defined.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: A document type describing specific procedures and detailed process steps with responsible persons.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: A document type describing specific procedures within a framework and process sequence with details and responsible persons.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document attached to a main document that is automatically released with the main document and subject to its own versioning.

attributes.name: archive_status
attributes.description: Whether the attachment is archived or active.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A non-controlled document attachment that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document and can be deleted directly.

attributes.name: publication_status
attributes.description: Whether the additional information is published or unpublished.

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person with defined roles and authorizations in the document management system.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The assigned role (Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Reader, Translator).

attributes.name: user_group
attributes.description: The group membership(s) of the user.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users assigned specific authorizations and access rights.

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: The type of user group (e.g. Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive).

attributes.name: authorization_level
attributes.description: The level of access granted to members of the group.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposed modification to an existing document managed without affecting the content or version history until implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current state of the change proposal (Pending, Implemented, Completed).

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before document validity expires to assess continued validity.

attributes.name: requested_extension_period
attributes.description: The period for which extended validity is being requested.

attributes.name: request_status
attributes.description: The current status of the validity extension request.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to declare a document invalid and archive it due to lack of continued validity.

attributes.name: request_status
attributes.description: The current status of the override request.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate and restore a previously invalidated document during its archiving period.

attributes.name: request_status
attributes.description: The current status of the reactivation request.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of users and user groups assigned to receive a document for notification, acknowledgement or access.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: The type of distribution (Email, Acknowledgement).

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process for document approval consisting of defined steps and participants with electronic signatures.

attributes.name: workflow_status
attributes.description: The current state of the workflow (In Progress, Completed, Rejected).

attributes.name: workflow_step
attributes.description: The current step in the workflow process (Creator, Review, Release).

objs.name: signature
objs.description: An electronic signature applied by a workflow participant as evidence of approval or completion.

attributes.name: signatory
attributes.description: The person who applied the signature.

attributes.name: signature_date
attributes.description: The date the signature was applied.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Reference information such as IT applications, organizational units, and risks linked to documents.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A user-specific view displaying documents and workflow tasks relevant to the user.

attributes.name: dashboard_type
attributes.description: The type of dashboard based on user role.

objs.name: report
objs.description: An evaluation of documents stored in the system with role-specific parameters and filtering criteria.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: The type of report (Status Report, Document Monitoring).

attributes.name: report_status_filter
attributes.description: Traffic light system indicating document status urgency.

objs.name: archive
objs.description: Storage location for invalidated documents with restricted access, retained for a defined period before physical deletion.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: The period for which archived documents are retained.

attributes.name: archive_access_group
attributes.description: The user group with read access to archived documents.

attributes.name: archive_retention_period
attributes.description: The time span before physical deletion of archived documents.

objs.name: translation
objs.description: A language-dependent version of a released document that must be checked and released separately.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language into which the document is translated.

attributes.name: translation_status
attributes.description: The current state of the translation (In Progress, Released).

objs.name: process
objs.description: A defined business process referenced by guidelines and work instructions.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: A department, location or business unit within the company.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Initiate creation of a new document by attaching an information object with a selected document type.

evts.name: edit_document
evts.description: Modify document content or metadata properties after creation.

evts.name: upload_file
evts.description: Upload an external file or document to a document object.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert document from source format to PDF upon saving.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Define and assign group and person-related authorizations and roles to a document.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Apply an electronic signature to a document by an authorized workflow participant.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Check document content according to technical and formal aspects as part of the approval workflow.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Approve and publish a document to make it visible to authorized readers.

evts.name: distribute_document
evts.description: Send document to users and user groups on the distribution list via email notification or acknowledgement request.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Require recipients to actively confirm receipt and understanding of a released document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient actively confirms acknowledgement of a document via workflow without signature.

evts.name: request_validity_extension
evts.description: System-generated request created 30 days before validity expiration to assess continued validity of a document.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Approve the continued validity of a document and update the Valid Until date by the default extension period.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Create a new version of a released document with updated content and retained prior version data.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an attachment as archived when it is no longer relevant to a new document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Propose a modification to an existing document without affecting its version history until implementation.

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Accept and incorporate a change proposal into a new version of the document.

evts.name: request_override
evts.description: Initiate a request to declare a document invalid and archive it due to lack of continued validity.

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: Declare a document invalid, revoke authorizations, and archive it after approval of the override request.

evts.name: request_reactivation
evts.description: Initiate a request to re-validate and restore a previously invalidated document during its archiving period.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validate an invalidated document and restore it to active status with a new version number.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Create a language-dependent translation of a released document content.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Check and approve a translated document version.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Approve and publish a translated version to authorized readers in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: view_document
evts.description: Access and read a released document as an authorized reader.

evts.name: generate_report
evts.description: Produce an evaluation report of documents with selected parameters and filtering criteria.
